title: Stand up the shared stack: one backend in shared tenancy mode, as pipeline-made stacks inside the Papyrus production account
description:
Outcome: Deploy the same Papyrus backend artefact once with tenancy mode "shared", as its own pipeline-made stacks inside an existing AWS account: the Papyrus production account (D10, Ryan 2026-11-13: no new account, we are at the account limit; Ryan confirmed the production account 2026-11-13; D9: no sandbox account of any kind). That account also holds every dedicated site and Prospectus, so the stacks carry the isolation layers from the design note's section Isolation inside an existing account: distinct name prefixes (shared production and shared staging), created and changed only by the release pipeline through checked change sets, one customer-managed KMS key per stack, permissions boundaries on every shared-stack role and a deny on shared resources for dedicated-site roles, reserved concurrency (PPY-f40a02), per-stack alarms and tag budgets. Uses the bootstrap stage (PAPYRUS_BOOTSTRAP_STAGE=1, OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS) for the first create, which keeps under CloudFormation's 2,500-resource limit. No site files are bundled into content-actions (python-bundle siteFiles empty); configuration comes from the site store. A staging copy of the shared stack is where every release lands first (PPY-1192d3).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/site-backend.ts, amplify/site-backend-config.ts (tenancy mode), amplify/data/schema.ts (OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS, bootstrap), amplify/functions/content-actions/resource.ts (setSiteFilesForContentActionsBundle), infra/amplify-app-shell (a shell for the shared newsroom app), docs/site-hosting.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/shared-stack-bootstrap.feature):
Scenario: The shared stack starts empty and serves no site
    Given a fresh shared stack
    When any host is requested
    Then the edge answers 404 and the API holds no tenant rows

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-46635e, PPY-7dc463. Blocks PPY-130eb2, PPY-49d059, PPY-f7ce77, PPY-7438d9. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-fea16f.

Testing: Synth tests for tenancy mode, the KMS key policy, the boundary and the deny; the staging stack created by the pipeline is the first real deploy (no sandbox account exists, D9); Amplify job log read before any retry (AGENTS.md rule).
Rollout: Staging first, then production of the shared stack, both by the release pipeline (nothing by hand, no ad hoc CLI). Needs Ryan's go for the first create of each (no production AWS action from planning). The staging stack unblocks the gated live halves of the auth and CDN spikes (PPY-d4fe2a, PPY-2784d2).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: sharing the account with every dedicated site and Prospectus means account-wide quotas are shared and admin credentials, an operator mistake or a suspension reach all of them. Mitigation: the five isolation layers above, quota shares measured and set before launch, changes only through change sets, Retain policies and point-in-time recovery. Accepted residual risk: an account-level failure reaches every tier.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: a new deployment with shared-mode rules.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
